subject: Partner-led discovery: CloudBridge — technical deep dive scheduling
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@cloudbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@gsipartner.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: CloudBridge x Redwood — discovery recap & next steps (partner-led)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks again for joining the call today. Quick recap from CloudBridge + GSI side:
- We saw a strong fit around your Dedicated and Private deployment options for regulated customers.
- Primary use case is marketplace-native app distribution + predictable latency for realtime features.
- Key evaluation items: integration touchpoints (marketplace listing, auth/KV sync), deployment topology, and pricing/commit guidance.

Next step: CloudBridge would like to run a partner-led technical deep dive with Redwood SEs to validate integration approach and discuss marketplace listing steps. Proposed 60-75 minute slots (all next week, PT):
- Tue 8/24 10:00-11:15 PT
- Wed 8/25 09:30-10:45 PT

Attached is a short mutual action plan (MAP) and an integration checklist to preview. Can you confirm Redwood SE availability (and preferred time)? If those times don't work we'd be happy to propose alternatives.

Also copying Tom from our GSI partner to align on marketplace requirements.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

--
Alicia Gomez
Partner Lead, CloudBridge
alicia@cloudbridge.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: CloudBridge-Redwood-MAP.pdf, partner-integration-checklist.xlsx

Both proposed slots mostly work for us; Mateo is available Tue 8/24 10:00-11:15 PT. If that works for Tom and the rest, I'll lock it in and circulate a calendar invite. If you prefer Wed morning instead, we can shift - please confirm.

Suggested attendees and roles:
- Mateo Alvarez (Senior Solutions Engineer) - technical deep dive / demo
- Marissa Cole (Partner Success) - MAP + go-to-market alignment

2) 25-30m - Architecture / integration options (Dedicated vs Private)
3) 15-20m - Marketplace listing steps + auth flows
4) 10-15m - Q&A & next steps / action items

I'll attach a calendar link here once we confirm the time. For pre-read, the MAP you attached is perfect - Mateo will review and surface any follow-ups beforehand.

Hi all - Tue 8/24 at 10:00 PT works for our team. Thanks for pulling this together.

Couple quick asks for the agenda so we can prep:
- Can we cover which endpoints will be used for marketplace routing and any required metadata sync?
- We'd like a short section on auth (SAML/OAuth) expectations for listing vs private deployments.
- Any guidance you can share around typical latency and throughput targets for the Dedicated offering (baseline numbers) would be helpful for our internal sizing.

If you can add those bullets to the agenda that'd be great. Otherwise confirm and we'll expect the calendar invite.

Thanks Tom - Tue 8/24 10:00 PT confirmed from our side. Suggested agenda bullets (can expand if helpful):
- Introductions & goals (5-10m)
- Demo of Redwood Dedicated + Private deployment topology (20m)
  - How marketplace routing interacts with tenant isolation
  - KV sync and prefix caching considerations
- Auth & listing requirements (10m)
  - OAuth flow for marketplace-linked deployments, SAML for enterprise customers
- Performance targets & sizing (10m)
  - Typical latency SLOs (p50/p95) and throughput per GPU slice (high-level ranges)
- Next steps / MAP alignment / owner assignments (10m)

I'd also like to check whether you want a live demo (walkthrough of the Console + API) or a deeper architecture session with sequence diagrams. We can do both in the 75-minute slot if folks want the full run.

I'll prepare a short pre-read with the performance numbers and an integration checklist. Marissa - if you want, I can attach the pre-read to the calendar invite.

Cheers,
